riviere.name: La rivière
riviere.alt: One wide river valley on a summer afternoon, painted in ink and gouache. At the top left a waterfall tumbles from a wooded cliff beside a mossy stone archway, the way up to the floods. The river runs down through the left side: a trout leaps from the water towards a cookie on a fishing line, a brown bear fishes in the shallows on the bend while a family of ducks paddles past, and on the grassy bank a frog leaps out of a big green bowl of noodles, slurping a noodle; a white wooden gate in the bottom left corner leads out to the valley. On the right the river widens: a line of red hearts floats down it from the far hills, a beaver naps on his stick dam, a glum fisherman sits on a jetty with an empty bucket while a heron behind him gulps a fish, and a still reservoir behind a stone wall reflects the clouds with one duck. A blue narrowboat glides along a canal with a heron on its roof, two children sew on a little raft in a stream, two frogs marry on a lily pad among the reeds of the marsh, a big bass basks in a round stone pond with goldfish swimming round it, a frog shoots out its tongue at a fly over a small pond, and on a little table by the water a goldfish in an aquarium waves at a wild fish outside the glass.

doors.label: Les crues
doors.hint: Walk under the mossy stone archway by the waterfall

crues.name: Les crues
crues.alt: Upriver at sunset, just after a storm, painted as one scene: the sun sets into the bay on the left while a dark rain cloud still pours on the right. On the hillside at the top left a beaver whooshes down the water chute of a stone weir and a hiker kneels at a bubbling spring; on a fence post an owl opens a big book against the setting sun. Below, the village high street is flooded: shop fronts stand in the water, ducks paddle past and a rowing crew of children rows a boat down the street. In the little square a duck flaps up to catch a jet from the stone fountain, a boy in a paper crown and cape proudly works a brass floor pump to blow up his tricycle tyre, a surprised water jug gasps 'Oh!' on a windowsill as water splashes out, a goat blinks as a big raindrop lands on its nose, and a girl sits on the river bank dangling her feet. On the right the swollen river rushes in foaming waves where a startled duck flaps, three ducks paddle happily in the downpour on the flooded bank, a mossy stone arch on the far bank leads back to the river valley, and on a grassy rise a fat toad sits on a crate playing a little black piano.

doors.label: La rivière
doors.hint: Walk back under the mossy stone arch to the river valley
